name: Pink Floyd

whyMatters.en: London band formed in 1965 from Sigma 6 / The Tea Set. Barrett-era psychedelic singles, then Waters/Gilmour concept albums; The Dark Side of the Moon (1973) and The Wall (1979) are the main chart and film references.
whyMatters.zh: 伦敦乐队，1965 年由 Sigma 6 / The Tea Set 演变成立。Barrett 时期迷幻单曲之后，是 Waters/Gilmour 概念专集；《The Dark Side of the Moon》（1973）与《The Wall》（1979）是主要榜单与电影参照。

shortBio.en: London progressive / psychedelic rock, 1965–2014. Barrett then Waters/Gilmour; Dark Side, Wish You Were Here, and The Wall are the core references.
shortBio.zh: 伦敦 progressive / 迷幻摇滚，1965–2014。Barrett 之后是 Waters/Gilmour；《Dark Side》、《Wish You Were Here》与《The Wall》是核心参照。

body.en:
Pink Floyd grew out of London architecture students Roger Waters, Nick Mason, and Rick Wright (Sigma 6, 1963), then The Tea Set with Bob Klose and Syd Barrett. By 1965 they were The Pink Floyd Sound—named after bluesmen Pink Anderson and Floyd Council—then simply Pink Floyd after Klose left.

Barrett steered early psychedelic sets and wrote Arnold Layne, See Emily Play, and much of The Piper at the Gates of Dawn (1967). After Barrett left, David Gilmour joined. Ummagumma (1969) entered the Billboard Top 100; Atom Heart Mother reached UK #1. Meddle (1971) and Obscured by Clouds (1972) refined the sound before The Dark Side of the Moon (1973)—with Dick Parry on sax and Clare Torry on vocals—became their first US #1, driven by Money.

Wish You Were Here (1975) and Animals (1977) addressed fame and politics; Snowy White toured on Animals while also working with Thin Lizzy. Stage shows mixed audio, visuals, and inflatables (notably a flying pig). Waters’ frustration with spectacle fed The Wall (1979), shaped with Bob Ezrin; Another Brick in the Wall was a chart single, and Alan Parker’s 1982 film starred Bob Geldof. Wright was dismissed for The Wall tour (session-only), then absent from The Final Cut (1983).

Waters left in 1985 and sued over the name; Gilmour and Mason continued with Wright back, releasing A Momentary Lapse of Reason (1987), The Division Bell (1994), and Pulse (1995). A brief Live 8 reunion (2005) with Geldof’s organizing brought Waters, Gilmour, Mason, and Wright together again; Wright died of cancer in 2008. The Endless River (2014) drew partly on Division Bell outtakes.
body.zh:
Pink Floyd 源于伦敦建筑系学生 Roger Waters、Nick Mason、Rick Wright（1963 年 Sigma 6），随后与 Bob Klose、Syd Barrett 组成 The Tea Set。1965 年改名 The Pink Floyd Sound——取自布鲁斯乐手 Pink Anderson 与 Floyd Council——Klose 离队后简称 Pink Floyd。

Barrett 主导早期迷幻演出，并写作《Arnold Layne》、《See Emily Play》及《The Piper at the Gates of Dawn》（1967）大部分曲目。Barrett 离队后 David Gilmour 加入。《Ummagumma》（1969）进入 Billboard 前 100；《Atom Heart Mother》获英国榜冠军。《Meddle》（1971）与《Obscured by Clouds》（1972）继续打磨声音，随后《The Dark Side of the Moon》（1973）——含 Dick Parry 萨克斯与 Clare Torry 人声——成为首张美国榜冠军专辑，并由《Money》推动。

《Wish You Were Here》（1975）与《Animals》（1977）写成功与政治；Snowy White 参加 Animals 巡演，同期也为 Thin Lizzy 工作。现场混合视听与充气道具（标志性飞猪）。Waters 对奇观淹没信息的不满促成《The Wall》（1979），与 Bob Ezrin 塑形；《Another Brick in the Wall》成为榜单曲，Alan Parker 1982 年电影由 Bob Geldof 主演。Wright 在 The Wall 巡演被降为参与者，未出现在《The Final Cut》（1983）。

Waters 1985 年离队并就乐队名起诉；Gilmour 与 Mason 召回 Wright，发行《A Momentary Lapse of Reason》（1987）、《The Division Bell》（1994）与现场专辑《Pulse》（1995）。2005 年在 Bob Geldof 促成的 Live 8 短暂重聚；Wright 2008 年因癌症去世。《The Endless River》（2014）部分取自 Division Bell 未发表素材。

body.en:
Before the concept albums, Pink Floyd were a London psychedelic residency band under Barrett: abstract rhythm and blues, awkward Chuck Berry covers, then original singles Arnold Layne and See Emily Play.

Astronomy Domine and Interstellar Overdrive on The Piper at the Gates of Dawn (1967) mark the early long-form experiments. Barrett left amid drug-related instability; Gilmour replaced him.
body.zh:
概念专集之前，Pink Floyd 是 Barrett 掌舵的伦敦迷幻驻场乐队：抽象节奏布鲁斯、别扭的 Chuck Berry 翻唱，再到原创单曲《Arnold Layne》《See Emily Play》。

《The Piper at the Gates of Dawn》（1967）上的《Astronomy Domine》《Interstellar Overdrive》标出早期长曲实验。Barrett 因毒品相关状态不稳离队，由 Gilmour 接替。

title.en: The Dark Side of the Moon

body.en:
Dark Side (1973) was their first US #1. Waters’ lyrics on fame, war, and social pressure sit with Gilmour/Wright playing, Dick Parry saxophone, and Clare Torry’s vocal on The Great Gig in the Sky.

Money’s cash-register tape loop and 7/4 verse made a radio single. Live scale grew into audio-visual shows with inflatables—including the flying pig later tied to Animals.
body.zh:
《Dark Side》（1973）是乐队首张美国榜冠军。Waters 关于名声、战争与社会压力的歌词，配合 Gilmour/Wright 演奏、Dick Parry 萨克斯，以及 Clare Torry 在《The Great Gig in the Sky》上的人声。

《Money》的收银机磁带循环与 7/4 主歌成为电台单曲。现场扩大为视听与充气道具——包括后来与《Animals》绑定的飞猪。

alt.zh: Roger Waters 与萨克斯手同台，Cow Palace，1975

title.en: The Wall and the Geldof film

body.en:
Waters’ concern that stage spectacle drowned his message led to The Wall (1979). Gilmour and Bob Ezrin shaped the demos; session players including Jeff Porcaro and Lee Ritenour appear on the tracks.

Another Brick in the Wall was a chart single. Alan Parker’s 1982 film cast Bob Geldof as Pink; power struggles around the film fed Gilmour–Waters conflict. Wright was out as a full member for the Wall tour and The Final Cut (1983).
body.zh:
Waters 担心舞台奇观淹没歌词信息，促成《The Wall》（1979）。Gilmour 与 Bob Ezrin 塑形样带；Jeff Porcaro、Lee Ritenour 等客座出现在音轨上。

《Another Brick in the Wall》成为榜单曲。Alan Parker 1982 年电影由 Bob Geldof 饰演 Pink；围绕电影的权力争执波及 Gilmour 与 Waters。Wright 在 Wall 巡演与《The Final Cut》（1983）时期不再是正式全职成员。

body.en:
Waters left in 1985 and sued to stop the name; Gilmour and Mason kept the band and brought Wright back. A Momentary Lapse of Reason (1987), The Division Bell (1994), and Pulse (1995) outsold Waters’ solo peaks commercially.

Live 8 (2005), organized with Bob Geldof’s involvement, briefly reunited Waters, Gilmour, Mason, and Wright. Wright died in 2008. The Endless River (2014) closed the studio catalog for Gilmour and Mason.
body.zh:
Waters 1985 年离队并起诉试图阻止乐队名继续使用；Gilmour 与 Mason 维持乐队并召回 Wright。《A Momentary Lapse of Reason》（1987）、《The Division Bell》（1994）与《Pulse》（1995）在商业上超过 Waters 个人高峰。

2005 年 Live 8（Bob Geldof 参与促成）短暂重聚 Waters、Gilmour、Mason、Wright。Wright 2008 年去世。《The Endless River》（2014）结束 Gilmour 与 Mason 的录音室目录。

alt.en: David Gilmour and Richard Wright on stage, Cow Palace, 1975
alt.zh: David Gilmour 与 Richard Wright 舞台照，Cow Palace，1975

body.en:
Cash-register loop, 7/4 verse, then a more conventional rock feel. Gilmour guitar and Parry sax are easy identifiers on Dark Side’s running order.

It is the clearest single-length entry into the album’s production method.
body.zh:
收银机循环、7/4 主歌，再转入更常规的摇滚拍感。Gilmour 吉他与 Parry 萨克斯是《Dark Side》曲序上易辨认的元素。

这是进入该专制作写法最清晰的单曲长度入口。

body.en:
John Lydon later walked back the Sex Pistols “I Hate Pink Floyd” T-shirt, calling the music great. Echoes (2001) and other reissues keep the catalog circulating.

Snowy White’s dual work with Thin Lizzy, the Geldof Wall film, and Live 8 are the clearest cross-band links in this chronicle.
body.zh:
John Lydon 后来收回 Sex Pistols「I Hate Pink Floyd」T 恤立场，称其音乐很好。《Echoes》（2001）等再版让目录持续流通。

Snowy White 兼任 Thin Lizzy、Geldof 主演的 Wall 电影，以及 Live 8，是本编年中最清楚的跨乐队联系。

note.en: Early singles and The Piper at the Gates of Dawn. Bob Klose left before the Barrett peak.
note.zh: 早期单曲与《The Piper at the Gates of Dawn》。Bob Klose 在 Barrett 高峰前离队。

note.en: Meddle through Animals; Dark Side and Wish You Were Here. Wright’s full membership ends around The Wall.
note.zh: 从《Meddle》到《Animals》；含《Dark Side》与《Wish You Were Here》。Wright 正式全职身份约在 The Wall 时期结束。

note.en: After Waters’ exit and litigation; A Momentary Lapse of Reason and The Division Bell.
note.zh: Waters 离队与诉讼之后；《A Momentary Lapse of Reason》与《The Division Bell》。

note.en: Barrett-era UK single; early psychedelic chart marker.
note.zh: Barrett 时期英国单曲；早期迷幻榜单标记。

note.en: Album-length concept production on mass charts; Wall film with Bob Geldof.
note.zh: 进入大众榜单的专辑长度概念制作；Wall 电影由 Bob Geldof 主演。
